worldcombat.skill.iceball.summary: Curl into a ball of ice and hurl it: every landed pass freezes on another layer and the next pass hits harder (up to 5), and a pass that sails past loops back for another try. The caster stays rooted the whole time; the last impact shatters and freezes a small patch of ground.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.description.0: Each pass deals %1$s ice damage; one cast lands up to %2$s passes.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.description.1: Every landed pass multiplies the next by %1$s (capped at %2$s); the ball flies at %3$s blocks/tick with a %4$s-block hitbox.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.description.2: The ball reaches %1$s blocks with %2$s s between passes; it shatters into %3$s blocks of ice that last %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.growth.0: From level %1$s each pass rises to %2$s and the flight extends to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.growth.1: From level %1$s each pass rises to %2$s, the cap to %3$s, and the flight extends to %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.use.0: Hurl an ice ball that loops back on its own
worldcombat.skill.iceball.use.1: Freeze on another layer and hit harder each pass
worldcombat.skill.iceball.use.2: Leave a patch of ice where it shatters
worldcombat.skill.iceball.preference.thi: On (thick): each landed pass multiplies by 2.3, the cap gains 15% and the ice patch is larger and longer, at 0.85x ball speed, +2 ticks between passes, +2 ticks recovery, +6 ticks cooldown and 0.9x base power per pass. Off (thin, the native form): 2x per pass, a faster ball and shorter interval and cooldown, at a lower cap and a smaller, shorter patch.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of throwing. Larger values open from further out.
world_combat.move.iceball.text.cap: Ice Ball landed %1$s passes and shattered
